title: CodeChef: Chef and Brain Speed
description: Chef's brain speed threshold is `x` bits/sec. His current measured speed is `y`. If y is strictly greater than x, Chef is prone to errors, return 'YES'. Otherwise return 'NO'.
starter_code:
def brain_speed(x: int, y: int) -> str:
    pass
solution:
def brain_speed(x: int, y: int) -> str:
    return 'YES' if y > x else 'NO'
explanation: Compares speed against threshold in O(1) time.
